refundPolicy.checkoutLine: Full refund within 14 days of your first payment (once per person) or of an annual renewal. Monthly renewals aren't refundable.
refundPolicy.termsParagraph: You can ask for a full refund within 14 days of your first subscription payment; this is available once per person (per email address). Annual renewal charges can also be refunded in full within 14 days of the renewal. Monthly renewal charges are not refundable. A refund ends your subscription immediately; to keep using MarketCatalyst you choose a plan again. Otherwise we do not refund partial billing periods, except where the law requires it. When you move to a lower plan, the unused part of your current plan is credited to your account and used automatically on your next invoices; credits are not paid out to your card.
refundPolicy.managePlanLine: Within 14 days of your first payment, or of an annual renewal, you can get a full refund. Your plan ends right away.
